title: Restrict Admin Access by Country
description: Only allow administrator logins from approved geographic locations to prevent unauthorized access.
help: To prevent a lockout, add your IP and country to the Authorized IPs list before enabling this feature. This restriction applies to all users with administrator capabilities. Note: Magic Links and other bypass mechanisms may still allow access.

authorized_countries.title: Authorized Administrator Countries
authorized_countries.description: Select which countries administrators are permitted to login from. This restriction only applies to users with administrator capabilities and requires a configured geolocation provider.
